# GowriAI.Ventures

GowriAI.Ventures builds and backs AI products for agentic operations, brand marketing, retrieval and memory, cybersecurity, math learning, and engineering and construction.

## Site
- Homepage: https://gowriai.ventures/
- Contact: mailto:hello@gowriai.ventures

## Super Intelligence
GowriAI.Ventures builds toward Super Intelligence (SI) through focused products in retrieval, agentic workflows, security, and evaluation. The venture platform focuses on increasingly capable systems that connect reasoning, knowledge, and action, with clear measures of usefulness and reliability.

## Initiatives
- [Yantriks.ai](https://yantriks.ai/)
  Agentic operations that learn from past team decisions, gather facts, run checks, and prepare next steps for human review.
- [Brandalytics.ai](https://brandalytics.ai/)
  A shared workspace for AI-powered brand research, campaign creation, and creative review, with brand context, guideline checks, and approvals.
- [CoreCortex.io](https://corecortex.io/)
  An evidence-first memory engine for building retrieval systems you can inspect, measure, and improve across real AI knowledge workflows.
- [ThreatVault.ai](https://threatvault.ai)
  Curated AI threat intelligence, adversarial technique libraries, and automated coverage analysis for teams securing AI systems.
  In partnership with [Cesta](https://cestatech.com/).
- [AgentFuzz.ai](https://agentfuzz.ai)
  AI vulnerability assessment and assurance for AI systems, aligned with OWASP LLM Top 10 and NIST AI RMF to identify prompt injection, data leakage, and emerging risks.
- [Mathz.app](https://mathz.app)
  Interactive math lessons from Algebra to Calculus where sliders, graphs, and direct manipulation build real intuition.
- [Parametri.ai](https://parametri.ai/)
  Transform blueprints and floor plans into intelligent, interactive documents with AI-powered text extraction, object detection, and design analysis.
- [NullVectorLab.com](https://nullvectorlab.com/)
  AI-native cybersecurity platform and services that unify threat intelligence, AI/LLM security, human risk, and risk prioritization into one operating layer.

## Capabilities
- Brand research, campaign creation, and creative review through Brandalytics.ai
- LLM systems and agentic workflows
- Retrieval, search, and knowledge systems
- Vision, document understanding, and evaluation systems
- Applied AI product design across brand marketing, cybersecurity, math learning, and engineering and construction

## About Us
GowriAI.Ventures builds and backs AI-powered products and businesses. We combine product development, technical expertise, and investment to grow a portfolio of initiatives, developed directly and through partnerships.
